info.title: arcadia agent IPC — delta v0.17.0 (phase 16)
info.description: Only the additions of v0.17.0 over v0.16.0 (phase 15). The full contract contracts/ipc.openrpc.json v0.17.0 is generated by a task: v0.16.0 + this delta, with info.version 0.17.0 [SED-030]. New methods session.create, session.update and session.delete; new errors SessionNotFound (-32017) and SessionOverlap (-32018); InvalidParams gains data.reason for the new methods; SessionItem gains source and editedAt, GameDetail gains sessionPlaySeconds, StatsGame/StatsPlatform/StatsSummaryResult gain manualSeconds. Nothing that exists changes meaning. None of the new methods sends a notification [SED-026].

methods.name: session.create
methods.summary: Creates a manual session (source manual, state ended, end_reason null) for a game and updates the game in the same transaction: total + activeSeconds unless includedInTotal, then first/last played and play count recomputed from the counted sessions [SED-003..SED-005, SED-012, SED-013]. Validated against the agent clock: end after start, end not in the future, start not before 1980, span up to 24 h, activeSeconds between 30 s and the span, no overlap with any tracked or manual counted session nor the open session [SED-015..SED-020]. Sends no notification [SED-026].

methods.name: session.update
methods.summary: Edits a closed, counted session (state ended) of any source: only the present fields change, source/state/end_reason stay, edited_at = now; pauses that leave a new [start, end] are clipped or dropped; the game total moves by the difference of activeSeconds and first/last played and play count are recomputed [SED-006, SED-007, SED-009, SED-012, SED-013]. A patch equal to the stored values writes nothing [SED-008]. Same time rules as session.create; for an imported session, or a patch without startedAt/endedAt, neither the 24 h span limit nor the overlap check apply [SED-018, SED-020, SED-021]. An open session is refused with -32002 and a discarded one with -32602 reason discarded [SED-022, SED-023].

methods.name: session.delete
methods.summary: Deletes a closed session and its pauses. A counted session takes its activeSeconds out of the game total (floor 0) and first/last played and play count are recomputed; a discarded one leaves the game row untouched [SED-010..SED-013]. Irreversible. An open session is refused with -32002 [SED-022].

SessionSource.description: Origin of a session [SED-002]. Readers are tolerant: an unknown stored value is passed through as is.

SessionItemAdditions.description: Properties added to SessionItem in v0.17.0 (both required) [SED-033]. The generated full contract merges them into SessionItem.

source.description: One of SessionSource, or an unknown stored value passed through.

editedAt.description: Instant of the last session.update that wrote something; null if never edited.

GameDetailAdditions.description: Property added to GameDetail in v0.17.0 (required) [SED-034]. totalPlaySeconds - sessionPlaySeconds is the manual adjustment of EDM-005.

sessionPlaySeconds.description: Sum of activeSeconds of the game's sessions with state ended.

StatsManualAdditions.description: Property added to StatsGame, StatsPlatform and StatsSummaryResult in v0.17.0 (required) [SED-027].

manualSeconds.description: The part of activeSeconds (totalSeconds in the summary) from sessions with source manual.

SessionEditReason.description: data.reason of -32602 for session.create and session.update (contract delta §4) [SED-015..SED-019, SED-023, SED-005, SED-032].

endedAt.description: null when the conflicting session is the open one

InvalidParams.description: Addition for v0.17.0: for session.create and session.update a broken session rule carries data {reason} with reason in SessionEditReason; a malformed request has no data [SED-032, SED-036].

SessionNotFound.description: session.update or session.delete with an unknown sessionId [SED-024].

SessionOverlap.description: The resulting [start, end) crosses a counted tracked or manual session of any game, or the open session [SED-020].

SessionActive.description: Addition for v0.17.0: also used by session.update and session.delete when the target session is open; data is the SessionRef of that session [SED-022].
